create_ego_charades_dataset: create a dataset from Ego4d Charades annotations with optional egocentric filtering and sentence embeddings
create_kinetics_dataset: create a Kinetics 400 dataset with label name mappings and sentence feature embeddings
create_cc_dataset: create a Conceptual Captions dataset that pairs video features with text features from HDF5 files
create_ego4d_clep_dataset: create an Ego4D CLEP dataset that pairs video features with narration text features using time offsets
create_data_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from a dataset with configurable batch size, workers, and shuffle settings
